I couldn't set up the daily digest. The scheduler refused my request because the gateway has no credentials for it, so nothing is scheduled yet. I haven't tried to work around that.

Here's what I'd schedule once the scheduler works: a digest at 09:00 America/Chicago each day, starting Thursday 15 October, covering new messages in #coastal-team since the previous digest. Money terms and finance documents would be left out and pointed to the channel, so the digest doesn't carry figures you may not be cleared to receive by DM.

Until it's set up, I can post a digest by hand whenever you want one. Someone with gateway access will need to fix the scheduler credentials before the recurring job can be created.
